title: Skydive the Wasatch

services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Tandem Skydiving is the perfect adventure for first-timers. We’ll take care of everything from liftoff to landing so you can focus on the rush of adrenaline, breathtaking views, and the unforgettable experience of flying! A Tandem Skydive means that you’ll be strapped to one of our awesome instructors who are trained not only in safety, but in making sure that you have the best experience possible! They’ll take you through a short training session where you’ll learn how the jump works, what your role is, how to position your body during freefall, and what to expect under the parachute. You don’t need to be an expert, your main job is to have fun, to take it all in, and enjoy the experience.
